#!/bin/bash
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp "${managed_inputs}" .
csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Has Multi" Managed_Inputs.csv > inputs.csv
#cat Managed_Inputs.csv
IFS=',' if [[ ! -f inputs.csv ]]; then echo "inputs.csv not found!" >&2 exit 1 fi
while read -r abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed has_multi; do data_ready=${data_ready,,} data_processed=${data_processed,,} stdy_type=${stdy_type,,} has_multi=${has_multi,,}
if [[ "$data_ready" == "yes" && "$data_processed" == "no" ]]; then if [[ "${stdy_type,,}" == "topmed" || "${stdy_type,,}" == "parent" || "${stdy_type,,}" == "substudy" ]]; then if [[ "$has_multi" == "yes" ]]; then echo "downloading data for $stdy_id" aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/rawData/ s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/${stdy_id}/metadata/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "${stdy_id}*.xml" --quiet else echo "$abv_name ($stdy_type) has no multi, skipping" fi fi fi done < inputs.csv
